findings.fix: Add value attributes to each option and prepend an empty placeholder: `<option value="">Select a shipping speed</option><option value="standard">Standard</option><option value="express">Express</option>` (and so on).
findings.location: Line with `<select id="shipspeed-select">` and its options
findings.violation: Options will submit their text content as values instead of explicit, code-safe values; "Standard" is also pre-selected by default instead of forcing the user to explicitly choose.

findings.evidence: Label says "(8 digits)" and placeholder says "Must be 8 digits", but the input has no pattern or length validation
findings.fix: Add `pattern="[0-9]{8}"` and `maxlength="8"` to the membership number input.
findings.location: Line with `<label id="member-label">` and the membership number input
findings.violation: The 8-digit requirement is documented only in text; there is no validation enforcement in the input attributes.

findings.evidence: `type="text"` for a field labeled "Preferred contact time"
findings.violation: A time field should use semantic HTML with `type="time"` for proper time selection UI and validation, not free-text input.
